blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — To help address the challenges of relentless flooding and scorching heatwaves, the Philippines, through the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), has partnered with two global climate networks to strengthen the capacity of local government units (LGUs) in implementing effective climate adaptation and mitigation measures. According to a DepEd statement issued on Wednesday, the DENR collaborated with the C40 Cities Climate Leadership Group (C40) and the Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate and Energy (GCom) to establish the Philippines Leadership on Climate Action and Localization (PhilLOCAL) program.
